## 2. ROCm stack status (IMPORTANT discrepancy, documented per mission rules)

| Layer | Version | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Kernel driver (ROCk/amdgpu) | 6.16.13 | **NOT modified** (mission rule) |
| Host userspace (`/opt/rocm`) | 7.2.1 (`rocm-core 7.2.1.70201-81~24.04`) | differs from wheel target 7.14.1 |
| Target wheels | `torch 2.12.0+rocm7.14.1` from `repo.amd.com/rocm/whl-multi-arch` | Phase 1 installs into an isolated venv |

The mission requires the 7.14.1 wheels and forbids host driver changes. The AMD
multi-arch wheels install a complete venv-local ROCm 7.14.1 userspace
(`rocm-sdk-core`, `rocm-sdk-libraries`, `rocm-sdk-device-gfx1100`); by default
dynamic resolution still prefers the host `/opt/rocm` 7.2.1 libraries for most
math libraries (torch's RUNPATH is `$ORIGIN/lib` only). Phase 1 measured both
configurations and standardizes on the **venv-consistent userspace** (activated
via `rocm_sdk.initialize_process()`, AMD's documented preload mechanism), with
the as-installed mixed state recorded as fallback. The AMD ROCm apt repository
returns 403 through this proxy (irrelevant to the wheel-only path and driver
changes are forbidden anyway).

## 3. Environment constraints discovered (documented, worked around)

1. **Egress proxy allowlist (intermittent).** Per-connection outcomes vary
   run-to-run: repeated probes of `https://github.com` produced both CONNECT
   timeouts and clean 200/206 responses; `ssh.github.com:443` consistently
   blocked; `api.github.com` and `codeload.github.com` consistently reachable.
   Reliable, deterministic transports on this host: (a) **plain-HTTP git
   transport `http://github.com`** (used by the preinstalled `/usr/local/bin/git`
   wrapper fallback; verified working for authenticated clone **and push** with
   the `gh` credential helper), and (b) the GitHub REST API. We created the
   dedicated branch `validation/gfx1100-rocm7141` (remote SHA verified:
   `2b4cacd6efd0`, equal to `main` at branch creation — no divergence
   introduced).
2. **Transport hardening.** `git config --global --add
   url."http://github.com/".insteadOf "https://github.com/"` (plus the SSH
   rewrite and http-scope credential helper) routes all git operations through
   the working path. A fallback tool (`scripts/api_git.py`) implements full
   fetch/push via the GitHub Git Data REST API for environments where only
   `api.github.com` is reachable (the gfx1151 host's documented situation).
3. **Hugging Face via the machine-configured mirror.** This host's orchestrator
   presets `HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com` (direct `huggingface.co` probes
   are intermittently dropped by the proxy). All pinned artifacts are downloaded
   through the mirror and **full-SHA256-verified against the official
   `protocol_lock.json` pins** — mirror use is permitted exactly under this
   condition.
4. **Background process handling.** Long-running jobs must be launched with
   `setsid` (a naive `nohup &` was killed by the orchestration shell's process-
   group cleanup — diagnosed, fixed, documented here for reproducibility).

## 5. Storage and data policy

- Workspace: `/workspace/yue2-sglang-rocm-w7900/` (93 G free) with
  `upstream/ benchmark/ evidence-repo/ models/ environments/ runs/ logs/ scratch/`.
  Workspace root is overridable (`YUE2_WORKSPACE`), never hard-coded.
- HF cache at default (`~/.cache/huggingface`, 1.8 T backing store).
- Binary artifacts (weights, WAV/FLAC) excluded from git via `.gitignore`
  (patterns: `*.safetensors *.wav *.flac *.npy models/ runs/ environments/
  upstream/ benchmark/ scratch/`).
- Downloads are pinned-revision + full-SHA256 verified
  (`scripts/download_pins.py` → `logs/phase3_download_manifest.json`).
